annotations.text: Surface 1 — the Market section, on the item detail. One unbroken block in the DETAILS / NOTES rhythm, not a card: the two plated cards above (WORTH NOW · PAID, DESIRE TO KEEP) stay the screen's weight. Rule for the buttons: filled brass = writes the person's data (the adopt action only); outlined brass = fetches; text = manages the match, rust for Remove. The age sits at the right of the reading's row, three lines above the actions; the just-refreshed frame shows the disabled Refresh with 'as of just now' in view, so it never reads as broken.

Surface 1 on the wishlist detail, where the market-price ghost was (after NOTES, before the sell-plan CTA), and the states sheet: Refresh's three looks, the four failure lines, every reading without a figure, the all-years lines, the picker's status and failures.

Surface 2 — one sheet, two phases. The notice at a medium detent; the picker at large. The sheet's bar (Cancel, title) is system chrome and drawn in the system face on purpose — bespoke inside the page, system in the bars. The card body picks; the footer strip under the hairline is the only place the outward link lives. Thumbnails are flat silhouettes standing in for Reverb's photos.

Surface 3 — recommended: one mono line under the ruler, in the meta register with only the amount lifted to body ivory. Never brass, never Archivo, so it cannot read as the total; one string with no wrapping, so the coverage travels with the number. The toggle beside it is drawn to show why not: it hides the person's total behind a state, puts a second figure in the hero's slot, adds a control to the most-seen screen, and — as drawn — splits the amount from its coverage into two elements, which spec P5 forbids.
